messages:
Priya S: Heads-up: console spike for fnhook validation rejects in eu-west for customer "acme-dev". Seeing new error code unexpected_keyset from validator. Anyone seen this shape?
Leo M: yea, saw a small blip earlier — adapters might have removed a param but models keep emitting it.
James K: can you paste an example payload?
Priya S: sure — partial:
```json
{
  "tool": "calendar.create",
  "args": {
    "title": "Planning sync",
    "start_time": "2026-03-20T15:00:00Z",
    "user_locale": "en-GB"
  }
}
```
Leo M: validator schema expects args.user_locale to be absent; these rejects go to strict-validate path which is inflating reject counts and billing signals.
Eva R: dashboard shows 3x reject rate since 03:10 UTC for that route. sampling for that route is currently 100%.
James K: two problems: (1) telemetry tag for fnhook.keyset_mismatch is missing so it's hard to filter, (2) routing policy sends rejects to the canary variant that lacks a permissive fallback — ends up increasing latency and error surface.
Priya S: proposal: flip to soft-validate for customer acme-dev for 24h, emit a dedicated telemetry tag, and temporarily route validation rejects to the permissive degen path until adapters are patched.
Leo M: +1. We should also add a console hint: "Keyset mismatch — suggest removing deprecated fields or enable adapter shim".
Eva R: i'll add a dashboard counter and row-level link to sample payloads. will also add a note to the rollout docs.
deploy-bot: no autopatch scheduled for schema changes — manual deploy required.
James K: for rollout checklist: ship a soft-validate toggle under routing-policy flags; require metric "fnhook.keyset_mismatch.count" emitted with route_id and customer_id tags.
Priya S: i'll open a small PR for telemetry + soft-validate toggle. tagging @Leo M for the routing change.
Leo M: i'll update the routing logic — move this route to fallback before the strict gate and add a short-lived override. also will add a tally in the sampling pipeline so we can backfill.
Eva R: add an alert: 50 rejects/min across region to avoid noisy pages.
Priya S: created issue: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PLAT-9012
James K: follow-up: split rejects into "unexpected_keys" vs "missing_required" so we can be more surgical.
Priya S: agreed. ok let's proceed. :thumbsup:
